name: Via Stitching
description: Stitch copper zones together with a grid of vias on a chosen net
description_full:
Fills the overlap of a net's copper zones (for example the top and bottom GND pours) with a grid of through vias, stitching the planes together.

Built on KiCad's modern IPC API (kicad-python / kipy), so it keeps working on KiCad 11 and later, where the legacy SWIG pcbnew bindings are removed.

Features:
- Hexagonal, square, or staggered via patterns with configurable diameter, drill, and spacing.
- Vias are placed only where the net is poured on every layer it occupies, inset enough to stay clear of other-net copper on those layers.
- Tracks of other nets are avoided on every copper layer, since a through via's drill crosses the layers the pour never touches.
- Rule areas that forbid vias are respected on every copper layer.
- Existing via and pad drill holes are avoided with a hole-to-hole margin.
- Clearances come from the board's netclasses.
- Optional keepouts for other nets' filled zones and for footprint bodies.
- All placed vias are bundled into a single named group so they can be deleted as a set.
